description_zh: 努尔苏丹·阿比什·乌拉·纳扎尔巴耶夫（1940 年出生）是哈萨克斯坦总统（1990-2019 年）。领导国家实现核武器放弃和多楔外交战略。2019 年首都从阿拉木图迁至努尔苏丹。作为三十年总统，他实现了哈萨克斯坦的稳定转型和独立。
description_en: Nursultan Abishovich Nazarbayev (born 1940) was President of Kazakhstan (1990-2019). Led the country through nuclear weapons abandonment and multi-pronged diplomatic strategy. In 2019, capital city moved from Almaty to Nursultan. As thirty-year president, achieved stability and transition to independence.
reason_zh: 纳扎尔巴耶夫的治理智慧体现在资源管理和多楔外交中。通过放弃核武器和稳定转型，哈萨克斯坦实现了独立和稳定。首都迁移体现了前瞻性思维。
reason_en: Nazarbayev's governance wisdom exemplified resource management and multi-pronged diplomacy. Through nuclear abandonment and stable transition, Kazakhstan achieved independence and stability. Capital relocation demonstrated forward-thinking governance.
